item.title: How to Make Money in RimWorld (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Wondering how to make money in RimWorld? Here are the most reliable income sources for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Quick Answer Tailoring and crafting (clothes, weapons, art) are the best stable income. Grow cash crops like smokeleaf or cotton, then sell goods at a trade outpost or caravan. Best Income Sources MethodIncome potentialEffort Tailoring (craft clothes)High, steadyLow–medium Art / sculpturesVery highMedium (needs Artistic pawn) Cash crops (smokeleaf, cotton)HighLow Drugs (yayo, flake)Very highLow (has risks) Caravan tradingHighMedium–high Tips Sell to outlanders and settlements — prices are better than at your own colony.

item.title: RimWorld Colony Wealth Guide — Manage Wealth, Reduce Raids (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: RimWorld colony wealth is the single biggest driver of raid size. Learn what counts, how it scales, and how to spend it — for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. What Counts as Wealth Buildings and items: everything constructed and every item stored. Colonists and animals: pawns add significant wealth. Silver and valuables: raw silver, gold, components count fully.
